aboutText: Based in Williamstown North, we have been providing precision CNC cutting, routing and profiling services to trades, manufacturers and businesses across Melbourne's west for years. Our facility on Bentley Street houses state-of-the-art CNC machinery capable of handling plywood, timber and a wide range of materials with exceptional accuracy. Whether you need trade panel cutting, custom prototypes or one-off parts, we deliver quality results on time.
servicesText: From large-scale trade panel cutting to bespoke prototype work, our Williamstown North workshop is equipped to handle projects of all sizes across Melbourne's west.

services.title: CNC Cutting
services.desc: High-precision CNC cutting for timber, plywood and composite materials, delivering clean accurate results every time.

services.desc: Complex shapes and detailed profiles routed with precision on our advanced CNC equipment for trade and commercial clients.

services.title: Trade & Panel Cutting

services.desc: One-off prototypes and custom-manufactured components produced to your exact specifications in our Williamstown workshop.
